import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))

# 1. Fraud distribution by transaction type
fraud_by_type = df.groupby('transaction_type')['is_fraud'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
bars = axes[0, 0].bar(fraud_by_type.index, fraud_by_type.values * 100, color=['#e74c3c', '#3498db', '#2ecc71'])
axes[0, 0].set_title('Fraud Rate by Transaction Type', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Fraud Rate (%)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylim(0, max(fraud_by_type.values * 100) * 1.2)
for i, bar in enumerate(bars):
    height = bar.get_height()
    axes[0, 0].text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 0.5,
                   f'{height:.1f}%', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10)

# 2. Transaction amount distribution by fraud status
fraud_amounts = df[df['is_fraud'] == 1]['amount']
legit_amounts = df[df['is_fraud'] == 0]['amount']

bins = np.linspace(0, max(df['amount']), 30)
axes[0, 1].hist(legit_amounts, bins=bins, alpha=0.7, label='Legitimate', color='#3498db', edgecolor='black')
axes[0, 1].hist(fraud_amounts, bins=bins, alpha=0.7, label='Fraud', color='#e74c3c', edgecolor='black')
axes[0, 1].set_title('Transaction Amount Distribution by Fraud Status', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Transaction Amount ($)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].legend(title='Transaction Status', title_fontsize=11)

# 3. Fraud distribution by hour of day
fraud_by_hour = df.groupby('hour_of_day')['is_fraud'].mean()
axes[1, 0].plot(fraud_by_hour.index, fraud_by_hour.values * 100, marker='o', 
                linewidth=2.5, markersize=8, color='#e74c3c')
axes[1, 0].fill_between(fraud_by_hour.index, 0, fraud_by_hour.values * 100, 
                        alpha=0.2, color='#e74c3c')
axes[1, 0].set_title('Fraud Rate by Hour of Day', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Fraud Rate (%)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_xticks(range(0, 24, 2))
axes[1, 0].set_xlim(-0.5, 23.5)
axes[1, 0].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 4. Scatter plot: Amount vs Hour with fraud indication
scatter = axes[1, 1].scatter(df['hour_of_day'], df['amount'], 
                            c=df['is_fraud'], cmap='coolwarm', 
                            alpha=0.6, s=50, edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Transaction Amount vs Hour (Colored by Fraud Status)', 
                    fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Transaction Amount ($)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_xticks(range(0, 24, 2))
axes[1, 1].set_xlim(-0.5, 23.5)

# Create custom legend for scatter plot
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
legend_elements = [Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', label='Legitimate',
                          markerfacecolor='#1f77b4', markersize=10, markeredgecolor='black'),
                   Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', label='Fraud',
                          markerfacecolor='#d62728', markersize=10, markeredgecolor='black')]
axes[1, 1].legend(handles=legend_elements, title='Transaction Status', title_fontsize=11)

# Adjust layout and add overall title
plt.suptitle('Credit Card Fraud Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, facecolor='white')
plt.close()
